about: A rule written once per ast-grep language, its two halves no-raw-fetch.typescript and no-raw-fetch.tsx, run through the real ast-grep: both halves report as the one rule no-raw-fetch (2.1-M226)

files.policy/ast-grep/rules/no-raw-fetch.types:
id: no-raw-fetch.typescript
language: TypeScript
severity: error
message: 'fetch is called only by desktop/web/src/platform; example desktop/web/src/platform/http.ts'
rule:
  pattern: fetch($$$)
files.policy/ast-grep/rules/no-raw-fetch.tsx.y:
id: no-raw-fetch.tsx
language: Tsx
severity: error
message: 'fetch is called only by desktop/web/src/platform; example desktop/web/src/platform/http.ts'
rule:
  pattern: fetch($$$)
